verdict.rationale: Milvus is documented as an open-source vector database, and Milvus Lite is described as ideal for quick prototyping on a laptop or in Jupyter. Lite shares the same API as Standalone and Distributed, so a developer can prototype meaningfully at no cost and keep the same client code when scaling. missing for 10: explicit pricing or license terms confirming zero cost, evidence of a hosted/managed free tier and its limits, independent corroboration of the free prototyping experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype on a meaningful free tier before paying anything

citations.quote: Milvus is an open-source vector database that suits AI applications of every size from running a demo chatbot in Jupyter notebook to building web-scale search that serves billions of users.
As a lightweight version of Milvus, it’s ideal for quick prototyping in Jupyter Notebooks or running on edge devices
Milvus Lite shares the same API with Milvus Standalone and Distributed, and covers most of the features
